answer_1.quote: This category requires the model to summarize the given long passage. It contains 3 datasets: SUM-QMSUM, SUM-GOVREPORT, and SUM-EN.SUM.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries of long documents and free-form answers to questions based on long contexts

answer_2.quote: For all the F-QA and ICL tasks, we adopt the F1 score of the generated tokens in comparison to the golden answers. For all the SUM tasks, we adopt the ROUGE-L-Sum metric as in the previous work.

answer_3.quote: Specially, for the SYR-NEEDLE task, we also adopt a third LLM as a judge to score the answers, and the score is normalized from (1,10) to (0, 1). Clause 3 Sonnet is utilized as the judge.
